`88-112`: _📐 Maintainability & Code Quality_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **Duplicated watch-reactor/bookmark boilerplate across two tests.** The `PrependWatchReactor` + `sync.Once` + delayed-bookmark-goroutine block is copy-pasted verbatim between `TestUserGroupsMapper_UserFor` (lines 88-112) and `TestRemoveUserFromGroup_DoesNotMutateCachedObject` (lines 502-526). Extracting a shared test helper (e.g. `addInitialBookmarkReactor(client *fakeuserclient.Clientset, resource string)`) would reduce drift risk if the k8s 1.35 bookmark workaround needs to change again.
♻️ Suggested helper extraction ```go func addInitialBookmarkReactor(client *fakeuserclient.Clientset, resource string) { var once sync.Once client.PrependWatchReactor(resource, func(action k8stesting.Action) (bool, watch.Interface, error) { fakeWatch, err := client.Tracker().Watch(action.GetResource(), action.GetNamespace()) if err != nil { return false, nil, err } once.Do(func() { go func() { time.Sleep(1 * time.Second) fakeWatch.(*watch.RaceFreeFakeWatcher).Action(watch.Bookmark, &userv1.Group{ ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{ ResourceVersion: "1", Annotations: map[string]string{metav1.InitialEventsAnnotationKey: "true"}, }, }) }() }) return true, fakeWatch, nil }) } ```
Also applies to: 502-526
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. In `@pkg/groupmapper/groupmapper_test.go` around lines 88 - 112, Extract the duplicated initial-bookmark watch setup from TestUserGroupsMapper_UserFor and TestRemoveUserFromGroup_DoesNotMutateCachedObject into a shared addInitialBookmarkReactor helper. Preserve the existing sync.Once, delayed bookmark goroutine, tracker watch, and error/return behavior, then replace both inline PrependWatchReactor blocks with calls to the helper using the appropriate client and resource. ```
--- `88-127`: _🩺 Stability & Availability_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _⚖️ Poor tradeoff_ **Hardcoded `time.Sleep(1s)` used to synchronize bookmark delivery with List completion — anti-pattern per repo guidelines.** The bookmark-emission goroutine relies on a fixed 1-second sleep to "let List complete," and the test then further compensates by manually seeding the indexer after `WaitForCacheSync` because the bookmark can race ahead of the List. This is exactly the pattern the repo's own contributing guide warns against: "Do not expect an asynchronous thing to happen immediately... Wait and retry instead." A slower CI runner could still race past 1s, and a faster one wastes a full second per subtest. Consider polling/retrying (e.g. wrap the bookmark send in a `wait.PollUntilContextTimeout`/retry keyed off actual List completion) instead of a magic sleep, or drop the manual re-seed since it appears to fully substitute for the bookmark's list-ordering purpose anyway. Based on learnings/coding guidelines: `**` (CONTRIBUTING.md) states, "Do not expect an asynchronous thing to happen immediately. Do not wait for one second and expect a pod to be running. Wait and retry instead."
